allowed_dependency_manifest.content: Fix any integer n with n > 1. Define f_n(x) = floor(n x) - sum from k=1 to n of (floor(k x) divided by k). Determine the real number(s) x where f_n(x) attains its maximum over all real x, and give the corresponding maximum value.

forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let $n$ be an integer greater than 1. For which real numbers $x$ is \\[\\lfloor nx \\rfloor - \\sum_{k=1}^{n} \\frac{\\lfloor kx \\rfloor}{k}\\] maximal, and what is the maximal value that this expression can take?

statement_nl: Let n be an integer greater than 1, and define F_n(x) = floor(n x) - sum_{k=1}^{n} floor(k x)/k. For every integer m with 0 <= m <= n-1, F_n(m/n) = m - sum_{k=1}^{n} floor(k m/n)/k.
